headline: Grumpy Walrus kept clipping 8:06-8:40 PM ET: nine MEPE buys (+~1.71M for ~670 ADA, now ~10.58M), ASCEND +208 (~308.2k), FLOW ~493 ADA over five orders, COCK +12k. The prefilter missed three small trims the trace found: 1M CLOVE for ~308 ADA (8:30 PM, ~26.0M left), ~1.2M BOLT for ~286 ADA (8:37 PM, ~26.0M left) and 500k CRAWJU for ~251 ADA (8:33 PM, 5.5M left). Net ADA ~-756; idle since 8:40 PM. MEPE now has 124 holders and ~26.4k ADA side, so it clears rule k's numbers, but it is a swarm launch with a serial early buyer (, 10 launches), so it stays Pass. EVIL sank to 5 holders (top wallet 49.6%) and HOWDY's side to ~5.0k: both deeper below their kill lines, already Pass. New FOSHIZLE and MSNEK launches show coordinated buyers and fresh-wallet swarms; Pass. COCK side ~163.4k (line 150k), ASCEND ~1.142M. No open tickets; nothing passes k/y.
learned: Lessons: the prefilter whale list only reported buys this run; three small sells (CLOVE, BOLT, CRAWJU) showed up only in the on-chain trace, so always trace both sides.
